_note: Example strengths — replace with your own (docs/mvp/14 section 4). 'Why you' only shows a strength when its condition matches verified facts about the buyer.

strengths.text: Stock in Jebel Ali (UAE), Dammam (KSA) and Mumbai (India) for standard sizes
strengths.when: the buyer or site is in or near those countries

strengths.text: Ex-stock delivery in 1–2 weeks; mill orders in 8–14 weeks
strengths.when: the order or project has a short delivery time (9 months or less) or is urgent

strengths.text: One vendor for pipe, fittings, flanges, valves, bolting and gaskets
strengths.when: the buyer needs 3 or more catalogue categories

strengths.text: Mill test certificates (EN 10204 3.1/3.2), third-party inspection supported; ISO 9001
strengths.when: the project names standards or specs (API, ASTM, NACE, ISO) or the owner is an oil & gas major

strengths.text: Registered with major owners' vendor lists (example: ADNOC, Aramco)
strengths.when: the project owner uses an approved vendor list (oil & gas owners)
the owner scores local content (Aramco, ADNOC, QatarEnergy, PDO, India public tenders)

strengths.text: Delivery to site or port, with export documents
strengths.when: the site or delivery port is known, or the buyer is in another country
